## Tier 0 — Pocket (12 atoms)

Memorize these. Cover ~80% of daily use.

| Glyph | Atom | Primary Use |
|-------|------|-------------|
| ✗ | ballot-x | state:failure |
| ● | black-circle | status:on |
| ▰ | black-parallelogram | progress:filled-cell |
| ✓ | check-mark | state:success |
| ◐ | circle-with-left-half-black | status:partial |
| — | em-dash | separator:structural |
| · | middle-dot | separator:inline |
| ⋯ | midline-horizontal-ellipsis | state:overflow |
| → | rightwards-arrow | flow:next |
| ⚠ | warning-sign | severity:warning |
| ○ | white-circle | status:off |
| ▱ | white-parallelogram | progress:empty-cell |
